tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish content as a clean, shareable public web page and get back a URL you can give to a human. Use this whenever you produce a report, plan, summary, analysis, doc, or any artifact the user should read or share — instead of dumping a wall of text into chat. Content is Markdown by default.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update the title or content of a page you previously published (same URL, new content).

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the pages you have published in this space (id, title, URL, view count).

tools.name: unpublish
tools.description: Delete a page you published so its URL no longer works.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish, list_pages · Public sink: publish · Destructive: unpublish.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish, list_pages · Public sink: publish · Destructive: unpublish

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
